generation_ack_protocol.grant_identity: receiver-local membership generation plus flow ID
generation_ack_protocol.ack_required_rule: the initial generation requires ACK closure; a later generation would require ACK closure if any continuing target decreased
generation_ack_protocol.ack_optional_rule: every admitted post-initial generation is a pure completion-release generation with non-decreasing continuing grants, ack_required=0, and no ACK
generation_ack_protocol.geometric_release_rule: a post-initial release generation may emit only when its active count is at most floor(the previous emitted vector active count divided by two)
generation_ack_protocol.retry_semantics: retry only unacknowledged flows in the current ACK-required generation
generation_ack_protocol.terminal_condition: the initial generation is fully acknowledged; every later generation has zero pending/retry state

initial_collection_protocol.scope: the first emitted vector in each receiver-local empty-to-nonempty membership epoch
initial_collection_protocol.timer_rule: schedule at min(last_registration_ns + quiet_ns, first_registration_ns + derived_hard_ns); every later initial registration reschedules only the quiet target
initial_collection_protocol.hard_tie_rule: a quiet target equal to the hard deadline is classified as a hard flush
initial_collection_protocol.flush_rule: a non-hard flush occurs exactly quiet_ns after the last registration; a hard flush occurs exactly derived_hard_ns after the first registration
initial_collection_protocol.post_initial_rule: after the first vector, retain the V8 12480-ns sliding quiet timer, five-window hard deadline, selective ACK, and geometric completion-release behavior
initial_collection_protocol.empty_epoch_rule: returning to an empty registered set resets only the epoch marker; membership generations remain monotonic

selection_policy: Freeze the topology-derived 16640-ns initial quiet window, 83200-ns hard deadline, replay identity, pilot, formal matrix, and V8 paired performance gates before execution. First replay seed-108 N=15 without reading performance, then qualify fresh seed 119 without reading performance. Holdout performance remains sealed until all 40 fresh mechanism cells pass. A failure rejects V10 and may not select another window, deadline, seed, N, arm, or subset.

scalability_holdout.required_control_frame_envelope: F_s(N) = grant sends + grant-ACK sends < 3N for every coalesced seed and N

scope_limits: The known replay, pilot, and holdout isolate membership changes by disabling remaining-aware progress refresh.
The 16640-ns initial quiet window is derived from twice the preregistered 8320-ns OS4 cross-leaf base RTT; the 83200-ns hard deadline is five such windows.
The post-initial membership quiet window remains 12480 ns; V10 changes only the initial collection timer mode and its separately configured quiet window.
V9 retains initial_collection_full_deadline=1 and its fixed 62400-ns behavior; V10 requires initial_collection_full_deadline=0.
The first-grant gate bounds every ungranted registered flow to one fixed BDP until the ACK-required initial generation arrives.
Every post-initial vector is an ACK-optional geometric pure completion-release vector.
Passing F<3N supports only synchronized N<=15 one-epoch traces, not arbitrary churn or a universal O(N) claim.
Performance metrics remain sealed until replay, pilot, and all 40 formal mechanism cells pass.
Any failed V10 gate rejects V10; changing a timer, seed, N, arm, or subset requires a separately preregistered version with fresh pilot and formal seeds.
